access.notes: Open-source plane-wave DFT code used as replacement for VASP. Must include support for spin-polarized calculations and stress-strain elastic constant workflow.
Standard PAW pseudopotentials for Ti, Al, C, Hf. Choose accuracy level consistent with a 600 eV cutoff.

Space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194). Atomic positions: Ti1 2a (0,0,0), Ti2 4f (1/3,2/3,z_Ti2), Al 2b (0,0,1/4), C 4f (1/3,2/3,z_C). Experimental lattice parameters: a=6.15 Å, c=18.58 Å. z_Ti2 ≈ 0.135, z_C ≈ 0.065 as described in the paper.
